items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: Oh he was regular, yeah. Yeah, after Nickerson quit.

ctx.x: Bebe played the drum with us too. With which band? Not the trombone player. Bill is the trombone player. Yeah. But Bebe was the drummer. But Bebe played with us too, but not regular, you know? Which band though? Silver Leaf.
Silver Leaf. I see. So we're getting some of the guys to substitute him. Yeah that's right. Was Willie Santiago in there regular or is the substitute?
Oh he was regular, yeah. Yeah, after Nickerson quit. That's right.
